# Mapper


<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

The mapper scores a report against four theme sets: the SRF enablers,
the SRF cross-cutting priorities, the GCM objectives and the SRF
outputs. For each theme, the LLM returns a relevance score from 0 to 1
and its reasoning. The report is the same for every theme set, and
prompt caching lets the calls after the first reuse it.

``` python
from cachy import enable_cachy
enable_cachy()
```

## Response models

The LLM replies with a
[`ThemeScores`](https://franckalbinet.github.io/iomeval/mapper.html#themescores),
which holds one
[`ThemeScore`](https://franckalbinet.github.io/iomeval/mapper.html#themescore)
per theme. `structured_llm` sends each model’s docstring to the LLM as
part of the reply format.

## Parsing

[`parse_res`](https://franckalbinet.github.io/iomeval/mapper.html#parse_res)
turns a reply into a list of score dicts, the form the pipeline saves.
[`sort_by_relevance`](https://franckalbinet.github.io/iomeval/mapper.html#sort_by_relevance)
orders the scores from most to least relevant.
[`get_top_ids`](https://franckalbinet.github.io/iomeval/mapper.html#get_top_ids)
keeps the IDs of the themes that score at least `min_score`, 0.66 by
default.

## Mapping a report

[`map_themes`](https://franckalbinet.github.io/iomeval/mapper.html#map_themes)
asks the LLM to score one set of themes against a report.
[`mk_system_prompt`](https://franckalbinet.github.io/iomeval/mapper.html#mk_system_prompt)
puts the report in the system prompt.
[`map_themes`](https://franckalbinet.github.io/iomeval/mapper.html#map_themes)
marks that system prompt for prompt caching with `cache_idxs=[0]`. The
later mappings of the same report read it from the cache, which costs
less than sending it again.

### map_themes

``` python
async def map_themes(
    sp:str, # Report system prompt from `mk_system_prompt`
    themes:str, # Themes to score, formatted as Markdown
    prompt:str, # Mapping prompt, such as `load_prompt('gcms')`
    model:str='claude-haiku-4-5', # LLM to use
    response_format:pydantic._internal._model_construction.ModelMetaclass=ThemeScores, # Pydantic model the reply must follow
    temperature:float=0, # Sampling temperature
    reasoning_effort:str=None, # `'low'`, `'medium'` or `'high'`; `None` for no extended thinking
    **kwargs
)->__main__.ThemeScores: # The LLM's scores
```

*Score `themes` against the report in `sp`, with the report cached*

``` python
from iomeval.extract import extract_sections
from mistocr.core import read_pgs

md = read_pgs('files/test/AAP%20Evaluation%20Report_final_')
report = await extract_sections(md)
```

``` python
n_tokens(report)
```

    6507

To keep the examples cheap, the system prompt holds only the first 500
characters of the extracted sections:

``` python
sp = mk_system_prompt(report[:500])
print(sp[:200])
```

The GCM objectives are Markdown already.
[`map_themes`](https://franckalbinet.github.io/iomeval/mapper.html#map_themes)

``` python
prompt = load_prompt('gcms')
res = await map_themes(sp, gcms, prompt, reasoning_effort=None, temperature=0)
```

## Mapping against every framework

[`map_all`](https://franckalbinet.github.io/iomeval/mapper.html#map_all)
maps a report against the SRF enablers, the cross-cutting priorities and
the GCM objectives. It then maps the SRF outputs linked to the top GCM
objective, which it looks up with
[`get_srf_outs`](https://franckalbinet.github.io/iomeval/themes.html#get_srf_outs).
When no GCM objective reaches the
[`get_top_ids`](https://franckalbinet.github.io/iomeval/mapper.html#get_top_ids)
threshold, it maps no outputs and returns `outs=None`. The four calls
share the cached report.
[`Report.map_all`](https://franckalbinet.github.io/iomeval/pipeline.html#report.map_all)
in the pipeline runs the same steps and saves each result.

### map_all

``` python
async def map_all(
    report:str, # Report text, usually the extracted core sections
    path:str='files/themes', # Folder of theme files, relative to the working directory
    prompt_path:str='files/prompts', # Folder of prompt files, relative to the working directory
    verbose:bool=True, # Log each step
    *, model:str='claude-haiku-4-5', # LLM to use
    response_format:pydantic._internal._model_construction.ModelMetaclass=ThemeScores, # Pydantic model the reply must follow
    temperature:float=0, # Sampling temperature
    reasoning_effort:str=None, # `'low'`, `'medium'` or `'high'`; `None` for no extended thinking
)->fastcore.basics.AttrDict: # Score dicts under `enbs`, `ccps`, `gcms` and `outs`; `outs` is `None` when no GCM objective reaches the threshold
```

*Map `report` against the SRF enablers, cross-cutting priorities, GCM
objectives and SRF outputs, in that order*

Run every mapping on the same 500 characters:

``` python
res = await map_all(report[:500])
```
